question: Do simple graph and definition-similarity scores recover atom pairs that occur in held-out source papers?
input_structure: undirected paper-level atom co-occurrence; edge weight is source-paper count
interpretation: Edge recovery is a coherence/usefulness diagnostic. It is not causal discovery, semantic novelty, or a molecule promotion test.
embedding_scope: TF-IDF over all 273 cluster definition strings; transductive descriptive vocabulary, not a temporal/nonleaky novelty evaluation.
